#!/usr/bin/env bats
# =============================================================================
# evals/tests/ablation-report.bats — cycle-130 Sprint 260 Task 3.8 (AC-3.10; PRD AC-8.1–8.3;
# SDD §5.12; DEC-0393, DEC-0399, DEC-0400, DEC-0416, DEC-0417, DEC-0434, DEC-0435)
#
# ablation-report.py on planted rows: fixtures/ablation-report/gen-fixtures.py writes four
# scenarios (main, boundary, exclusions, partial; the header there lists every planted
# number) into the file tmpdir; setup_file builds the three full reports once against the
# real suite file evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml.
# =============================================================================

setup_file() {
  TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
  REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$TESTS_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
  export REPO_ROOT
  export REPORT="$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/ablation-report.py"
  export SUITE="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml"
  export FX="$BATS_FILE_TMPDIR/fx"
  mkdir -p "$FX"
  python3 -I "$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/ablation-report/gen-fixtures.py" "$FX"
  for s in main boundary exclusions; do
    python3 -I "$REPORT" --runs "$FX/$s/runs.jsonl" --manifests "$FX/$s/manifests" --suite "$SUITE" \
      --out "$FX/$s/report.md" --json "$FX/$s/report.json" >/dev/null
  done
}

setup() {
  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ar.XXXXXX")"
}

teardown() {
  find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
  rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true
}

dec() {  # dec <scenario> <arm> <jq path under the decision>
  jq -r --arg a "$2" ".decisions[] | select(.arm == \$a) | $3" "$FX/$1/report.json"
}

cmp_of() {  # cmp_of <scenario> <arm> <metric> <jq path under the comparison>
  jq -r --arg a "$2" --arg m "$3" ".decisions[] | select(.arm == \$a) | .comparisons[] | select(.metric == \$m) | $4" "$FX/$1/report.json"
}

report() {  # report <scenario> <out-prefix> [extra args]
  local s="$1" o="$2"; shift 2
  run python3 -I "$REPORT" --runs "$FX/$s/runs.jsonl" --manifests "$FX/$s/manifests" --suite "$SUITE" \
    --out "$o.md" --json "$o.json" "$@"
}

@test "AR-1 each rule branch on planted rows: -0.05 tight Keep, 0.00 at -20 % cost Remove, 0.00 similar cost Simplify, wide Inconclusive, +0.04 Investigate" {
  [ "$(dec main a2_no_sprint_plan .state)" = "keep" ]
  [ "$(cmp_of main a2_no_sprint_plan hidden_test_pass_rate .d)" = "-0.05" ]
  [ "$(cmp_of main a2_no_sprint_plan hidden_test_pass_rate '.hi < 0')" = "true" ]
  [ "$(dec main a3_one_voice .state)" = "remove" ]
  [ "$(dec main a3_one_voice '.c == -20')" = "true" ]
  [ "$(dec main a5_no_flatline .state)" = "simplify" ]
  [ "$(dec main a5_no_flatline '.c == -5')" = "true" ]
  [ "$(dec main a6_one_window .state)" = "inconclusive" ]
  [ "$(cmp_of main a6_one_window hidden_test_pass_rate '.lo < 0 and .hi > 0')" = "true" ]
  [ "$(dec main a7_effort_medium .state)" = "investigate" ]
  [ "$(cmp_of main a7_effort_medium hidden_test_pass_rate .lo)" = "0.04" ]
  grep -qF '| A2 | `a2_no_sprint_plan` | 12 tasks | -0.050 [-0.052, -0.048] | n/a (build-only) |' "$FX/main/report.md"
  grep -qF '**Investigate** | investigate: any applicable primary has lo > 0 (hidden_test_pass_rate)' "$FX/main/report.md"
}

@test "AR-2 exactly at threshold: d = -0.03 is not Keep and is Remove at c = -15 (inclusive) or Simplify; hi = 0 is not Keep (strict); w = -15 is Remove" {
  [ "$(cmp_of boundary a2_no_sprint_plan hidden_test_pass_rate .d)" = "-0.03" ]
  [ "$(cmp_of boundary a2_no_sprint_plan hidden_test_pass_rate .hi)" = "-0.03" ]
  [ "$(dec boundary a2_no_sprint_plan '.c == -15')" = "true" ]
  [ "$(dec boundary a2_no_sprint_plan .state)" = "remove" ]
  [ "$(dec boundary a5_no_flatline .state)" = "simplify" ]
  [ "$(cmp_of boundary a6_one_window hidden_test_pass_rate '.hi == 0')" = "true" ]
  [ "$(cmp_of boundary a6_one_window hidden_test_pass_rate .d)" = "-0.04" ]
  [ "$(dec boundary a6_one_window .state)" = "inconclusive" ]
  [ "$(dec boundary a6_one_window .rule)" = "inconclusive: d < -0.03 (hidden_test_pass_rate)" ]
  [ "$(dec boundary a3_one_voice '.w == -15')" = "true" ]
  [ "$(dec boundary a3_one_voice .state)" = "remove" ]
}

@test "AR-3 a cap failure scores 0 on the primary, is listed, and the labelled sensitivity figure (cap failures excluded) differs" {
  [ "$(jq -r '.cap_failures | join(",")' "$FX/exclusions/report.json")" = "excl-1-a2_no_sprint_plan-fb-01-t1" ]
  # fb-01: trials 0 (cap, the row says 0.9), 0.40, 0.40 → 0.266667 against a1's 0.40
  [ "$(cmp_of exclusions a2_no_sprint_plan hidden_test_pass_rate '.pairs[] | select(.task_id == "fb-01") | .arm_value')" = "0.266667" ]
  [ "$(cmp_of exclusions a2_no_sprint_plan hidden_test_pass_rate .d)" = "-0.011111" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.sensitivity.rows[] | select(.arm == "a2_no_sprint_plan") | .comparisons[0].d == 0' "$FX/exclusions/report.json")" = "true" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.sensitivity.label' "$FX/exclusions/report.json")" = "sensitivity (cap failures excluded) — no decision uses this" ]
  grep -qF '## Sensitivity figure: sensitivity (cap failures excluded) — no decision uses this' "$FX/exclusions/report.md"
  grep -qF -- '- `excl-1-a2_no_sprint_plan-fb-01-t1` (`a2_no_sprint_plan`, fb-01 t1, cap_phase IMPLEMENT, USD 12.00)' "$FX/exclusions/report.md"
}

@test "AR-4 a degraded cell is dropped from both arms (pairwise); --exclude-degraded false counts it" {
  [ "$(cmp_of exclusions a3_one_voice hidden_test_pass_rate '.pairs[] | select(.task_id == "fb-02") | .diff == 0')" = "true" ]
  [ "$(cmp_of exclusions a3_one_voice hidden_test_pass_rate '.pairs[] | select(.task_id == "fb-02") | .control_runs | join(",")')" = "excl-1-a1_full-fb-02-t1,excl-1-a1_full-fb-02-t3" ]
  [ "$(cmp_of exclusions a3_one_voice hidden_test_pass_rate '.dropped[] | .run_id')" = "excl-1-a1_full-fb-02-t2" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.exclusions[] | select(.run_id == "excl-1-a3_one_voice-fb-02-t2") | .reason' "$FX/exclusions/report.json")" = "degraded: IMPLEMENT models_used global.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5" ]
  report exclusions "$T/nodeg" --exclude-degraded false
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.decisions[] | select(.arm == "a3_one_voice") | .comparisons[0].pairs[] | select(.task_id == "fb-02") | .diff' "$T/nodeg.json")" = "-0.243333" ]
}

@test "AR-5 an arm with 11 of 36 cells excluded (30.6 %) reads Inconclusive-by-degradation although its valid cells read +0.05 with lo > 0 (guard first, DEC-0393); excluded rows are listed" {
  [ "$(cmp_of exclusions a5_no_flatline hidden_test_pass_rate .d)" = "0.05" ]
  [ "$(cmp_of exclusions a5_no_flatline hidden_test_pass_rate '.lo > 0')" = "true" ]
  [ "$(dec exclusions a5_no_flatline .state)" = "inconclusive" ]
  [ "$(dec exclusions a5_no_flatline .label)" = "Inconclusive-by-degradation" ]
  [ "$(dec exclusions a5_no_flatline .excluded_share)" = "0.305556" ]
  [ "$(dec exclusions a5_no_flatline .rule)" = "inconclusive (degradation guard, evaluated first): excluded share 0.306 > 0.25" ]
  [ "$(jq '[.exclusions[] | select(.arm == "a5_no_flatline")] | length' "$FX/exclusions/report.json")" -eq 11 ]
  grep -qF '| `excl-1-a5_no_flatline-fb-01-t1` | `a5_no_flatline` | fb-01 | 1 | contaminated | contaminated |' "$FX/exclusions/report.md"
  grep -qF '| `excl-1-a2_no_sprint_plan-rf-01-t3` | `a2_no_sprint_plan` | rf-01 | 3 | transport_error | transport_error |' "$FX/exclusions/report.md"
}

@test "AR-6 build-only arms (A2, A4, A5, A6) are decided on the pass rate alone; all-type arms on both; a refused review-catch row is listed, never counted" {
  for a in a2_no_sprint_plan a4_no_gates a5_no_flatline a6_one_window; do
    [ "$(dec exclusions "$a" '.primaries | join(",")')" = "hidden_test_pass_rate" ]
    [ "$(dec exclusions "$a" '[.comparisons[].metric] | join(",")')" = "hidden_test_pass_rate" ]
  done
  for a in a3_one_voice a7_effort_medium; do
    [ "$(dec exclusions "$a" '.primaries | join(",")')" = "hidden_test_pass_rate,defect_catch_rate" ]
  done
  [ "$(jq -r '.listed[] | select(.run_id == "excl-1-a4_no_gates-rc-02-t1") | .reason' "$FX/exclusions/report.json")" = "not applicable: a4_no_gates does not run review-catch tasks" ]
  [ "$(dec exclusions a4_no_gates .cells_seen)" -eq 36 ]
  [ "$(dec exclusions a4_no_gates .state)" = "keep" ]
}

@test "AR-7 defects are the catch-rate unit: rc-01's 8 defects weigh 8 in the decision interval and 1 in also_report" {
  [ "$(cmp_of exclusions a7_effort_medium defect_catch_rate .unit)" = "defects" ]
  [ "$(cmp_of exclusions a7_effort_medium defect_catch_rate .n)" -eq 18 ]
  [ "$(cmp_of exclusions a7_effort_medium defect_catch_rate '.pairs[] | select(.task_id == "rc-01") | .defects')" -eq 8 ]
  [ "$(cmp_of exclusions a7_effort_medium defect_catch_rate .d)" = "-0.222222" ]
  [ "$(cmp_of exclusions a7_effort_medium defect_catch_rate .task_level.n)" -eq 4 ]
  [ "$(cmp_of exclusions a7_effort_medium defect_catch_rate .task_level.d)" = "-0.125" ]
  [ "$(cmp_of exclusions a7_effort_medium defect_catch_rate '.defect_identity | join(",")')" = "ids,rate" ]
  [ "$(dec exclusions a7_effort_medium .state)" = "keep" ]
  grep -qF 'also_report (tasks, decides nothing): d [lo, hi] = -0.125' "$FX/exclusions/report.md"
}

@test "AR-8 agent_error scores what its tree earns (DEC-0417)" {
  # bf-01: 0.50 (agent_error), 0.52, 0.52
  [ "$(cmp_of exclusions a7_effort_medium hidden_test_pass_rate '.pairs[] | select(.task_id == "bf-01") | .arm_value')" = "0.513333" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.arms.a7_effort_medium.by_status.agent_error' "$FX/exclusions/report.json")" -eq 1 ]
}

@test "AR-9 Not run (cut) from --cuts and --not-run, a pre-declared Inconclusive-by-power, each with its figure" {

# =============================================================================
# evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml — cycle-130 Loa 2.0 component ablation suite
#
# SDD §3.3 (structure reproduced), extended by Sprint 258 Task 1.6: the
# tasks block with the smoke root, phase_defaults, phase_sets, cost_hint, each
# arm's phase-set override and took-effect rule ids, and the full pre-registered
# rules block (D-A5; mirrored in NOTES before the first run, DEC-0383).
#
# Readers: execute-agent.sh / lib/sandbox-mount.sh (arms[].toggles via
# resolve_arm_toggles), pipeline-run.sh (phase_defaults, phase_sets,
# arms[].phases, arms[].effort), took-effect.sh (arms[].took_effect),
# run-ablation.sh (trials, caps, priority, cut_ladder, arms[].task_types),
# ablation-report.py (rules), validate-suite.sh (arm ids for the leakage check,
# task_types against the known types).
#
# task_types: `all` | `build` (= feature-build, bug-fix, refactor) |
#   `review-catch` | a single build type. An arm is never scheduled, and a row
#   never reported, on a type outside its declaration (DEC-0400, DEC-0406).
# took_effect: rule ids took-effect.sh evaluates per trial (DEC-0418); a miss is
#   infrastructure_error and pauses the arm. `applicability_refused` is the
#   smoke's evidence line that the planner refused the arm on a review-catch task.
# =============================================================================
name: ablation-2.0
version: 1
source_commit: "ba11b860"   # the pin: the Sprint 259 completion tree (rc.5 + the #1267 mount fix + the harness; .claude/ identical to the Sprint 258 completion tree, DEC-0529; the per-batch .claude/ delta vs 4d69c3c4 is in MANIFEST.json, DEC-0392)
agy_opt_in: false
tasks:
  root: grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0/tasks
  manifest: grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0/MANIFEST.sha256
  smoke_root: grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0/smoke
suite_version: 1
trials: {build: 3, review-catch: 3}      # D-A4: review-catch trials 3, not 5, under the gate pipeline
cut_ladder: ["A5, A6, A7 not run", "A2 and A3 build trials 3 -> 2", "A3 review-catch trials 3 -> 2"]   # DEC-0397; A0, A1, A4 keep 3
caps: {cycle_usd: 1500, run_usd: 12, reserve_usd: 250}   # reserve released to A7 when the re-verification rule needs no run (DEC-0398)
priority: [a0_bare, a1_full, a2_no_sprint_plan, a3_one_voice, a4_no_gates, a7_effort_medium, a5_no_flatline, a6_one_window]
cost_hint: {build: 7, review-catch: 8}   # USD per run before any actual exists (run-arms/run-ablation est_next fallback)

# Session defaults per phase (SDD D-4.3). A6's continued session carries the
# caps of the phase it is in; A0's BARE caps are PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 x FIX.
phase_defaults:
  models:
    PLAN: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    IMPLEMENT: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    FIX: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    BARE: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    REVIEW: global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1
    AUDIT: global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1
  # REVIEW/AUDIT 60 turns / 30 min: the Sprint 258 smoke saw a review-catch AUDIT hit 40 turns after writing its
  # verdict (DEC-0490); BARE stays the implementer-side sum (PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 x FIX)
  max_turns: {PLAN: 30, IMPLEMENT: 60, REVIEW: 60, FIX: 40, AUDIT: 60, BARE: 170}
  timeout_min: {PLAN: 15, IMPLEMENT: 25, REVIEW: 30, FIX: 15, AUDIT: 30, BARE: 70}
  tools: "Bash,Read,Grep,Glob,Write,Edit,Task,WebFetch"   # identical for every arm, A0 included
phase_sets:   # D-4.1: A1's phases per task type; FIX runs only after a CHANGES_REQUIRED gate
  review-catch: [REVIEW, AUDIT]
  build: [PLAN, IMPLEMENT, REVIEW, FIX, AUDIT, FIX]

arms:
  - {id: a0_bare, label: A0, task_types: [all], toggles: {loa_mount: false}, phases: [BARE], effort: high,
     took_effect: [no_dot_claude, no_system_prompt, no_audit_rows, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a1_full, label: A1, task_types: [all], toggles: {}, took_effect: [all_phases_present, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a2_no_sprint_plan, label: A2, task_types: [build], toggles: {sprint_plan: false},
     phases: [IMPLEMENT, REVIEW, FIX, AUDIT, FIX],
     took_effect: [no_plan_phase, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a3_one_voice, label: A3, task_types: [all], toggles: {companion_voice: false}, took_effect: [one_voice_planned, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a4_no_gates, label: A4, task_types: [build], toggles: {gates: false},
     phases: [PLAN, IMPLEMENT],
     took_effect: [no_gate_phases, enforce_env_false, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}   # build only: on a review-catch task the gates are the task (DEC-0400)
  - {id: a5_no_flatline, label: A5, task_types: [build], toggles: {flatline: false},
     took_effect: [no_flatline_rows, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a6_one_window, label: A6, task_types: [build], toggles: {context_resets: false},
     took_effect: [implementer_single_session, gates_separate_sessions, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a7_effort_medium, label: A7, task_types: [all], toggles: {effort: medium},
     took_effect: [effort_flag_medium, skill_effort_stripped, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a8_no_ceremonies, label: A8, absent: true,
     evidence: "no /meeting command, skill or sosyete config key at 4d69c3c4 (grep -rli sosyete .claude/ docs/; ls .claude/commands .claude/skills)"}

#!/usr/bin/env bats
# =============================================================================
# evals/tests/run-ablation.bats — cycle-130 Sprint 260 Task 3.2 (SDD §5.9, §3.4;
# AC-3.2, AC-3.5, AC-3.7; DEC-0405, DEC-0407, DEC-0417, DEC-0418, DEC-0429, DEC-0435)
#
# run-ablation.sh against stubs only: the pipeline is fixtures/ablation-pipeline-stub.sh,
# the grader fixtures/ablation-grade-stub.sh, docker fixtures/ablation-docker-stub.sh
# (also first on PATH, so fingerprint.sh never reaches a real docker); ablation-row.sh,
# took-effect.sh, freeze.sh and validate-suite.sh are the real ones. The pinned source is
# a throwaway git tree (LOA_ABLATION_SOURCE_TREE); the suite is the frozen one, read only
# (cases that break the hard gate work on a copy). No model call, no docker.
# =============================================================================

setup() {
  TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
  REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$TESTS_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
  RA="$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/run-ablation.sh"
  FX="$TESTS_DIR/fixtures"
  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/rab.XXXXXX")"
  mkdir -p "$T/bin" "$T/src/.claude"
  cp "$FX/ablation-docker-stub.sh" "$T/bin/docker"
  cp "$FX/docker-stub.sh" "$T/bin/docker-stub.sh"
  printf '%s\n' '#!/usr/bin/env bash' 'echo "2.1.300 (Claude Code)"' > "$T/bin/claude"
  chmod +x "$T/bin/docker" "$T/bin/docker-stub.sh" "$T/bin/claude"
  echo "# loa" > "$T/src/.claude/CLAUDE.loa.md"
  ( cd "$T/src" && git init -q && git add -A && git -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t commit -q -m src )
  SHA="$(git -C "$T/src" rev-parse HEAD)"
  for i in $(seq 1 36); do echo "self-check base task-$i: PASS hidden 1/1"; done > "$T/self-check.log"
  export PATH="$T/bin:$PATH" EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN="$T/bin/claude" LOA_ABLATION_SOURCE_TREE="$T/src"
  export LOA_ABLATION_RETRY_WAIT_S=0 LOA_ABLATION_POLL_S=0.2 STUB_LOG="$T/stub.log" STUB_GRADE_LOG="$T/grade.log"
  unset STUB_RULES STUB_HANG STUB_CLI STUB_COST STUB_GRADE_FAIL LOA_ABLATION_WATCHDOG_S LOA_ABLATION_WATCHDOG_GRACE_S DOCKER_STUB_NO_IMAGE LOA_ABLATION_OUTAGE_BREAKER
  RES="$T/res"
}

teardown() {
  find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
  rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true
}

# ra <args…> — the runner with the stubs and the test locations
ra() {
  run "$RA" --source-commit "$SHA" --results-root "$RES" --self-check-log "$T/self-check.log" \
    --pipeline-bin "$FX/ablation-pipeline-stub.sh" --grade-bin "$FX/ablation-grade-stub.sh" --docker-bin "$T/bin/docker" "$@"
}
rules() { printf '%s\n' "$@" > "$T/rules"; export STUB_RULES="$T/rules"; }
row() { jq -c --arg r "$1" 'select(.run_id == $r)' "$RES/runs.jsonl"; }

@test "RAB-7 drift guard (DEC-0407): an init claude_code_version other than MANIFEST cli_version fails the batch (state failed, drift populated, nothing more launches); a foreign model id does too" {
  rules '* drift_cli'
  ra --arms a1_full --tasks bugfix-01,bugfix-02,bugfix-03 --trials-build 1 --batch dr1 --concurrency 1
  [ "$status" -eq 3 ]
  S="$RES/dr1/STATUS.json"
  [ "$(jq -r '.state' "$S")" = failed ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.drift.field, .drift.expected, .drift.got' "$S" | tr '\n' ' ')" = "cli_version 2.1.299 9.9.9 " ]
  [ "$(wc -l < "$T/stub.log")" -eq 1 ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.drift.run_id' "$S")" = "$(awk '{print $1}' "$T/stub.log")" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.status' "$RES/runs.jsonl")" = infrastructure_error ]
  # a resume of a drifted batch is refused
  ra --batch dr1 --resume
  [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
  rules '* drift_model'
  ra --arms a1_full --tasks bugfix-01 --trials-build 1 --batch dr2
  [ "$status" -eq 3 ]
  jq -e '.drift.field | startswith("models_used.")' "$RES/dr2/STATUS.json" >/dev/null
  # DEC-0545: the requested model is absent; got is the sorted models_used keys, expected the manifest model
  [ "$(jq -c '[.drift.field, .drift.expected, .drift.got]' "$RES/dr2/STATUS.json")" = '["models_used.PLAN","claude-opus-5-5",["global.anthropic.claude-haiku-9-9"]]' ]
}

@test "RAB-8 watchdog (DEC-0429): a pipeline that hangs past the deadline (with a running record, or with none) is SIGTERMed and rowed interrupted" {
  rules '*-bugfix-01-* hang' '*-bugfix-02-* hang_norecord'
  export LOA_ABLATION_WATCHDOG_S=2 LOA_ABLATION_WATCHDOG_GRACE_S=2
  ra --arms a1_full --tasks bugfix-01,bugfix-02 --trials-build 1 --batch w1 --concurrency 2
  [ "$status" -eq 3 ]   # no trial completed
  [ "$(row w1-a1_full-bugfix-01-t1 | jq -r '.status')" = interrupted ]
  [ "$(row w1-a1_full-bugfix-02-t1 | jq -r '.status')" = interrupted ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.synthesized_by' "$RES/w1/a1_full/bugfix-02-t1/meta/pipeline.json")" = run-ablation.sh ]
  [ "$(grep -c 'watchdog: .* SIGTERM' "$RES/w1/run.log")" -eq 2 ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.per_arm.a1_full.excluded' "$RES/w1/STATUS.json")" = 2 ]
  # every interrupted trial without a reported cost is charged the run cap
  [ "$(jq -r '.spend.assumed_cap_trials' "$RES/w1/STATUS.json")" = 2 ]
}

@test "RAB-9 --max-usd: USD 5 per trial under max 12 launches two (0+7 hint, 5+5) and cuts the third (10+5 > 12) with cuts[] populated; exit 1" {
  export STUB_COST=5
  ra --arms a1_full --tasks bugfix-01,bugfix-02,bugfix-03,bugfix-04 --trials-build 1 --batch c1 --concurrency 1 --max-usd 12
  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
  S="$RES/c1/STATUS.json"
  [ "$(wc -l < "$T/stub.log")" -eq 2 ]
  [ "$(jq -c '.cuts' "$S")" = '[{"reason":"max_usd","spent":10,"in_flight_reserved":0,"max":12,"est_next":5,"trials_launched":2,"at_trial":3}]' ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.state' "$S")" = partial ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.spend.spent_usd, .spend.max_usd' "$S" | tr '\n' ' ')" = "10 12 " ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.resume_cursor' "$S")" = 2 ]
  grep -q 'cut: max_usd 12 reached after 2 trials' "$RES/c1/run.log"
}

content.text:
I found one high-severity defect. The rest are medium or low, plus some test gaps. The parts you asked me to check most closely are correct: the predicate order (degradation guard, then investigate, keep, inconclusive, remove, simplify), the strict thresholds (`d < -0.03`, `hi < 0`, `lo > 0`, `c/w <= -15`), the 90% percentile interpolation, pairing against `a1_full`, the H1 and A4 directions, and the MDE formula all match the header and the yaml. Everything below comes from reading the code, except one small bootstrap simulation I ran in `/tmp`, which used none of the PR's code.

### 1. HIGH: the per-defect catch-rate unit is fake on real rows
`head/evals/harness/ablation-report.py:477-483` (used at `:541-546`, `:558`, `:637`)

```python
missed = row.get("defects_missed")
if missed is None and isinstance(row.get("recall"), dict):
    missed = row["recall"].get("missed")
...
return [float(row[CATCH])] * n, "rate"
```

- `ablation-row.sh` (row object, lines 343-405) never writes `defects_missed` or a `recall` object. It only writes `defects_seeded`, `defects_caught`, `defect_catch_rate` and `flags`. The grader does produce `recall.missed` (`ablation-grade.sh:1319`), but the row builder drops it.
- So on production rows, every review-catch task takes the "rate" fallback. Each task's single task-level difference is copied `defects_seeded` times into `res["diffs"]`.
- The bootstrap then treats those copies as independent units. The interval gets too narrow, `n` is overstated, and the MDE shrinks, so the `inconclusive_by_power` check rarely fires on catch rate.
- I simulated the bootstrap with the same seed:
  - Task diffs `[-0.5, 0, 0, 0]` give [-0.375, 0.000]. That is not Keep.
  - The same data copied out by defect count (8+2+4+4) gives [-0.306, -0.139]. That is Keep.
  - So one bad task out of four flips the decision.
- The yaml pre-registers `units: {defect_catch_rate: defects}`. That only means something with real defect ids, and the report never gets them.

### 2. MEDIUM (test gap tied to #1): the fixtures exercise a code path production never reaches
`head/evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-report/gen-fixtures.py` (`row()`, `with_missed`)

- The fixtures add `defects_missed`, a field real rows never have. AR-7's per-defect result and AR-1/AR-2's catch numbers therefore test the "ids" path.
- The real "rate" path is tested only on `rc-02`, in one scenario.
- AR-20 says the fixtures "hold the real row shape", but `--validate` only checks that required keys exist, so it accepts the extra field.

### 3. MEDIUM, partly speculative: the defect count is taken from all rows, including ones never decided
`head/evals/harness/ablation-report.py:391-394`

- `task_defects` is the maximum `defects_seeded` over every row. That includes smoke, no-manifest and non-applicable rows, because it runs before `_classify`.
- If a smoke task shares an id with a real task but has a different defect count, `n` changes for every arm.
- If no row of a task carries `defects_seeded`, then `defect_vector` returns `None`. That task's catch pairs add nothing to `diffs`, catch `n` can hit 0, and the arm reads "inconclusive: no valid pair" even though `task_level` has data.
- The second case is speculative: it depends on whether the grader always fills `defects_seeded`.

### 4. LOW–MEDIUM: the sensitivity figure can come out as Inconclusive-by-degradation
`:452` together with `:486-491` and `:744`

- In the `cap_excluded=True` analysis, cap failures become invalid cells (`reason = "cap_failure (sensitivity figure)"`), and `excluded_share` counts them.
- An arm with more than 25% cap failures therefore shows "Inconclusive-by-degradation" in the sensitivity table instead of the comparison without cap failures. The figure exists to show that comparison.
- The sensitivity table never decides anything, so the impact is limited to what readers see.

### 5. LOW: the column headers are hardcoded to 90%
`:813`, `:941`

- `"pass-rate Δ [90 % CI] | catch-rate Δ [90 % CI]"` stays the same when `--level` is something else. The header marks the deviation, but the columns mislabel the intervals.

### 6. LOW / design notes, not defects against the header
- **`:195`:** every interval reseeds `random.Random(seed)` with the same seed. Arms with equal `n` get identical resample index streams, so their bootstrap errors are perfectly correlated. The header documents this, but the expected-false-positives sentence (`:761`) assumes independent comparisons.

head/evals/harness/ablation-grade.sh:1412 — stripping heredoc bodies before the path scan treats every heredoc as data, but a heredoc fed to an interpreter is executed code: `python3 - <<'PY'\nopen('/root/secret')\nPY` and `bash <<EOF\ncat /mnt/data/answers.txt\nEOF` are clean in head and hits in base. Restrict the exemption to words that cannot be filesystem reads (e.g. a leading `/word` used as a command word in prose/heredoc text), or add the host roots and treat a trailing slash as a path.
head/evals/harness/ablation-grade.sh:1442 — `after_closing_quote` treats any quote right before the word as closing a glued token, so an empty literal defeats detection: `cat ''/root/secret` (and `""/root/x`, `"$EMPTY"/root/x`) is now clean, while base flags it. It should require a non-empty quoted token (or a `$VAR` expansion) before the quote.
head/evals/harness/ablation-grade.sh:1444 — `in_quotes` counts raw `'`/`"` characters from the start of the whole command, so an earlier apostrophe flips the parity: `echo "it's"; ls /root` returns None (base: outside_path). head/evals/harness/ablation-grade.sh:1432 — `"=" in w` exempts any path word containing `=` ("no path component carries =" is false): `cat /home/operator/x=1` and `/root/a=b` are now clean. Exempt only words where `=` precedes the first `/`-separated component, or regex-shaped words.
head/evals/harness/ablation-grade.sh:1396 — in Bash text `hidden` is now matched case-sensitively and only next to `/._=-`, so `cat tests/Hidden_cases.py` and `cd /workspace && ls hidden` are clean (base: hidden), and so are camelCase `hiddenTests` or `*hidden*` globs. The yaml's `units: {defect_catch_rate: defects}` cannot hold without per-defect ids in the row. Carry `recall.missed` into the row, or bootstrap catch rate by task.
head/evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-report/gen-fixtures.py:1 — the fixtures add `defects_missed` to review-catch rows, a field real rows never have, so AR-1/AR-2/AR-7 exercise the "ids" path while production always takes the "rate" path above. The "real row shape" claim (AR-20) only holds because `--validate` checks required keys, not extra ones.
head/evals/harness/ablation-report.py:391 — `task_defects` is the max `defects_seeded` over every row, before `_classify` drops smoke, unmanifested and inapplicable rows, so an undecided row can change the defect count n for every arm. A task none of whose rows carries `defects_seeded` contributes no catch pairs at all, which can push an arm to "no valid pair".
head/evals/harness/ablation-report.py:452 — in the sensitivity analysis (cap_excluded=True) cap failures become invalid cells and count toward `excluded_share`, so an arm with more than 25% cap failures shows Inconclusive-by-degradation in the sensitivity figure instead of the cap-failures-excluded comparison the figure exists to show.
Verdict: CHANGES_REQUIRED
